hero.headline: Carousels rendered from JSON.
hero.description: LumenClip is a JSON-driven carousel rendering engine. Describe every slide once as a spec, fill its image and text slots, and get pixel-exact PNGs ready for TikTok and Instagram.

steps-1.headline: Describe the slides in JSON
steps-1.description: Canvas, fonts, theme, and every image, text, and shape layer are explicit fields. Nothing is guessed.

steps-2.headline: Turn it into a template
steps-2.description: Declare named slots for images, copy, colours, and lists. A list slot repeats slides for variable-length carousels.

steps-3.headline: Fill the slots
steps-3.description: Pick uploads, a collection image, a seeded random pick from a collection, or a Pexels or Pinterest result.

steps-4.headline: Render and ship
steps-4.description: Get one PNG per slide plus a ZIP, then publish or schedule the carousel to TikTok or Instagram.

features-1.headline: Bundled typefaces
features-1.description: 21 display, serif, script, and handwritten faces plus Inter, rendered with the real font files on the server.

features-2.headline: Stacks and grids
features-2.description: Absolute, stack, and grid groups with gaps, padding, corner radius, and clipping for collages and lists.

features-3.headline: Validation with paths
features-3.description: Every error carries a code and a JSON Pointer, so a bad field is easy to find in a pasted spec.

features-4.headline: API keys and MCP
features-4.description: Render from scripts with a workspace API key, or let an agent call the same tools over MCP.

features-5.headline: Calendar
features-5.description: Scheduled and published posts sit on one calendar, with in-app reminders before they go out.

features-6.headline: Deterministic output
features-6.description: The resolved spec is stored with every render, so a historical render always reproduces the same pixels.
